items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I took in four of the guys myself, Ray Nance, [Al] Hibbler, Skippy, somebody else.

ctx.x: Betty Roché. When we got to Cincinnati, it turned out that the hotels were filled. So I took in four of the guys myself, Ray Nance, [Al] Hibbler, Skippy, somebody else. Skippy was – Skippy’s a very light-skinned guy. Did you know Skippy?
